en.headline: Police seize 1.55 million illicit cigarettes in Ta Kwu Ling raid
en.dek: A 33-year-old man was arrested after officers from the Tai Po anti-triad unit raided a metal warehouse in Ping Che on Monday afternoon.
body: Police arrested a 33-year-old local man after raiding a suspected illicit cigarette storage warehouse in Ta Kwu Ling on Monday afternoon.

Officers from the Tai Po police district anti-triad unit searched a metal warehouse in Ping Che during an anti-smuggling operation targeting cigarette storage and distribution. They seized 1.55 million duty-not-paid cigarettes with an estimated market value of about HK$7 million and a duty potential of over HK$5 million.

The man was arrested on suspicion of possessing or handling goods to which the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance applies. Police said the operation had hit triad income sources and the case was handed to relevant departments for follow-up.
Under the ordinance, dealing with, possessing, selling or buying illicit cigarettes carries a maximum penalty of HK$2 million and seven years' imprisonment.

zh.headline: 警方打鼓嶺搗破私煙倉 檢155萬支私煙拘一人
zh.dek: 大埔警區反三合會組周一午後在坪輋一金屬倉庫搜出約155萬支未完稅香煙，市值約700萬元，一名33歲本地男子被捕。
body: 警方周一午後在打鼓嶺搗破一個懷疑私煙貯存倉庫，拘捕一名33歲本地男子。
大埔警區反三合會組人員在反走私行動中搜查坪輋一金屬倉庫，檢獲約155萬支未完稅香煙，估計市值約700萬元，應課稅值逾500萬元。
該名男子涉嫌管有或處理適用於應課稅品條例的貨品被捕。警方表示行動有效打擊三合會收入來源，案件已交相關部門跟進。
根據應課稅品條例，處理、管有、售賣或購買私煙，最高可判罰款200萬元及監禁七年。
